headline: Authorized new superintendent contract negotiations and an insurer timeline request on Spark Center HVAC repairs; tabled a policy adoption until next month.
summary: The meeting covered the merger study, the FY27 and FY28 budget context, the Spark Center renovation and HVAC repairs, and policy updates. Members approved the consent agenda and the superintendent's report. They also authorized new contract talks with Superintendent Wilmer Chavarria and tabled a policy adoption until next month.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including the September 9, 2026 meeting minutes, bill approvals, and policies C2 and C6.
Approved Robert Millar as the representative to the upcoming VSBA business meeting, where members vote on resolutions.
Tabled the public hearing and adoption of Policy 4.2.2 Create Written Governing Policies until next month.
Approved the internal monitoring report for Policy 2.2 Treatment of Staff.
Approved a motion authorizing Nicole Mace to contact the insurance company for an updated timeline on Spark Center HVAC repairs.
Approved the October Superintendent's Report to the Board.
Determined, after executive session, that the superintendent has demonstrated satisfactory performance.
Approved authorizing the board president to enter formal negotiations with Superintendent Wilmer Chavarria for a new contract.
